_doc: Round 5 paint-over for n1 at 144 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/n1_144.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (-1, -1), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: face_base
layers.why: Face critic 2: clear the old stamp to a clean face plane (FC-P35).

layers.name: eye
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'narrow, slanted almond eyes with a heavy 2-3 px dark upper-lash block, a dark-to-warm iris ramp and a small catchlight; make it about 1 px narrower and tilted up at the outer corner, a 2 px near-black upper-lash block running 1 px past the outer corner, an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan; lift the lid 1 px'. N1 (face 2, consistency): the same almond as the idle, turned 3/4 (outer corner toward the ear).

layers.name: brow
layers.why: N1: a set brow over the eye (focused)

layers.name: blush
layers.why: Attractiveness 3 (round 4): 'lock one signature expression (half-lidded smirk, one brow slightly raised) and carry it into the back and Q frames; never ship an open O mouth in a key pose'; face 2: 'the default mouth is a 2-3 px asymmetric smirk; blush as 1-2 px strokes under the eye, not a blob'.

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: Face 2 (N1): 'a Q (and N1) face override: mouth closed or a small determined smirk (1-2 px)'.
